elena-sales: Heads up — Contoso asked for MSA + DPA redlines back by EOD. Procurement also needs PO path. Blocking POC kickoff. Can legal advise on MSA/DPA acceptability? @maria-legal

maria-legal: Reading now. Main ask: delete section 7.2 (liability cap exception) + add data residency clause. We also need their contract contact and whether they can accept our standard HSM/KMS addendum. @jake-ops any procurement constraints?

jake-ops: Procurement says they want net45 and vendor W-9 on file. Also need invoice to reference PO #45678. We can accept net30 with prepay credit for POC. Anna — can you confirm PO timing?

anna-customer: @jake-ops PO may take 2 weeks. Net45 preferable. POC needed next week though — any workaround?

sam-se: For POC we can do an eval with hosted credits and a simplified SOW — no billing until production. Suggest sign only DPA + SOW for trial and defer MSA. Would that unblock?

maria-legal: We can do a POC addendum (SOW) + standard DPA. Need to confirm data transfer addendum language. If they insist on MSA redlines, ask them to share a redline doc. Uploads welcome.

chris-security: Quick Q — Contoso's security questionnaire flagged SOC2. We have SOC2 Type II + ISO certs PDF. I'll drop the certs here. Also need clarification on encryption at rest with customer KMS — they asked for BYOK. We support KMS integration in Dedicated; hosted needs a KMS bridge exception.

elena-sales: Dropping proposed path: 1) Send SOW + DPA immediate 2) Provide hosted eval credits 3) Start POC. Meanwhile legal negotiates MSA redlines. Does that sound ok? :thumbsup:

anna-customer: That works. We can sign SOW today.

maria-legal: Fine. Elena, please upload DPA with our standard addendum. I'll prepare a short POC SOW template and include signature routing steps. For signature: do they use DocuSign? Who from Contoso signs MSA vs SOW?

anna-customer: We'll use DocuSign. I am the technical sponsor but legal will sign MSA. I can route.

elena-sales: Great. @jake-ops can you confirm invoice/PO mapping to SOW (we'll set price to $0 for the trial) and KYC docs required?

jake-ops: Confirmed — set SOW amount $0, include 'PO pending' line with PO # to be added later. W-9 required before production invoicing.

ops-bot: Deploy schedule updated — reserved eval capacity Wed 09:00-17:00 UTC pending signed SOW.

sam-se: I'll provision sandbox and share access. Also snippet for SOW billing clause to avoid accidental charges:

```
Billing: Trial period is non-billable. Upon move to production, standard billing applies per order form.
```

Can legal confirm?

maria-legal: Ok. Quick redline note: add "data controller instructions" clause to DPA and tighten deletion timeline to 15 days. I'll post redline to Google Drive and share link.

elena-sales: Thanks everyone. I'll send DPA+SOW bundle to Contoso and tag this thread with the DocuSign envelope id once sent. Blocking list cleared for now.
